+30% [ICON_STRENGTH] Combat Strength against other [COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Gunpowder[ENDCOLOR] units.[NEWLINE]-15% [ICON_STRENGTH] Combat Strength if adjacent to a [COLOR_NEGATIVE_TEXT]Friendly Unit[ENDCOLOR].
Barbarian spawn rates reduced slightly, and camps do not spawn two units when created. Groovy, man.

In Game Setup, do not show the leader/civ details of other human players on other teams (if they are not choosing Random Leader).[NEWLINE]When loading a savegame, do not show the leader/civ details for players on other teams that you have not met in-game.

One random Victory Type (Culture, Diplomatic, or Spaceship) is enabled when any player enters the Atomic Era. All other victories are disabled (note: Time and Domination Victories are always possible).
Production, Research, etc. all take a fair amount longer than when playing on Standard Speed. The game is balanced to take longer but still feel like a normal game.
Normal Game Speed with Marathon Research Times
This extremely long game speed will allow almost an entire normal game's worth of turns for each era.
The number of turns required to complete various tasks is compressed. Good for players who don't like to wait around too much.
Players start at war with one another and may not go to peace.
Enable bad outcome events from Vox Populi's Player and City Events System.
Allows all players to accumulate Great General and Great Admiral points from fighting Barbarians.
Enable Civilization-specific events from Vox Populi's Player and City Events System.
In order to be eliminated from the game, a player must have all of his Cities AND Units destroyed. A player who remains alive for 10 turns with no Cities or Settlers will receive a free Settler.
AI leaders will not receive an aggression boost towards players who are getting close to winning the game. NOTE: This option is redundant if 'Disable AI Victory Competition' is enabled.
Disables matching Civilizations to certain map conditions. Starts will be totally random.
AI leaders will not resent other players for their progress towards Victory Conditions. This makes the game significantly easier.
Players take turns based on their war status.[NEWLINE]Warring human players take their turns sequentially.[NEWLINE]Non-warring players take their turns simultaneously.
Turns will end automatically when timer finishes.[NEWLINE]0 = Game dynamically scales the turn time.
Enable positive outcome events from Vox Populi's Player and City Events System.
Prevents this game from being loaded while mods are active. Useful for competitive games.
Enable neutral outcome events from Vox Populi's Player and City Events System.
Each time the game is loaded, the random number seed is regenerated. This means if you attack after loading, you might get a different result from the first time you played.
Barbarians and their Encampments do not appear on the map. Rebel (barbarian) uprisings from [ICON_HAPPINESS_4] Unhappiness do not occur.
Whatever the state of war or peace the game begins with, the players may not change once the game is underway. Useful for mods, like World War II.
Players are not allowed to burn cities down after capturing them.
Disables the Culture Overview Screen. This affects only the UI and does not alter any of the core game mechanics.
Disables espionage system. No spies are granted.
Ancient Ruins do not appear on the map.
No penalties or benefits from happiness.
Disables the World Congress system. No proposals or sessions will happen, and Diplomatic Victory will not be possible.
Disables policy system. No policies granted in the game.
Disables religion system. No Faith earned. Pantheons and Religions may not be founded.
Disables research system. Civilizations are locked at the starting technology level.
If enabled, you cannot sell technology to another civilization unless you have researched that technology yourself.
Disables the tutorial popups for the duration of the game.
Disables the Vassalage System. No vassals can be created.
HUMAN players are only ever allowed to build or own one city.
Disables Advanced Spy Missions. Spies only provide their passive benefits while stationed in a City. NOTE: This option does nothing if 'No Espionage' is enabled.
Players may make game-long permanent alliances with one another, allowing shared victory.
Players (other than the host) can enter/exit the game whenever they want. Players are sent turn notifications when it is their turn.
Players may choose to defer selecting a Social Policy until later, instead of needing to pick immediately.
Players may choose to defer selecting a Unit Promotion until later, instead of needing to pick immediately.
No combat animations are played when units attack.
No animations are played when units move.
The rate at which Barbarians spawn is greatly increased.
Instead of acting as they normally do, a random personality will be picked for each AI leader, making the game more unpredictable.
If enabled, you can sign Research Agreements with other civilizations.
Players take their turns in order.
Players take their turns at the same time.
Enable trade (miscellaneous) outcome events from Vox Populi's Player and City Events System.
Display raw numbers next to diplomatic modifiers. In addition, AI leaders will never hide negative modifiers.
The people of India cry out as you claim her lands. Please do not divide us through this reckless behavior.
India is not afraid of your soldiers. Should you attack, it will be a terrible mistake.
Though I follow the path of peace, I will not tolerate wanton aggression. India does not fear a brute such as yourself.
That is what I was afraid of.
I only hope that is indeed the case.
We shall see how honest you really are.
Let's see if your actions betray your words.
Taking advantage of someone's trust is despicable. Everyone will know of your betrayal.
If you wish to fight, I certainly will not back down.
Trading blows with you will be my pleasure. Make sure that you put up a fight.
This should be fun. I revel in every opportunity to defeat someone like you.
Very well. A maelstrom of death shall envelope us both.
I must admit, I've been looking forward to this.
It is about time that our armies meet on the battlefield.
I shall sow my fields with your blood.
You fool. You have made a terrible mistake.
You have made a terrible decision.
You are pathetic. I would say that I was surprised by this but that would be a lie.
You are clearly unfit to be the ruler of even the most pathetic kingdom.
Your day of judgement will come.
What an awful decision on your part.
You would attack us? How foolish.
History will mock you for this.
I am not surprised you wish to fight me. Our conflict over the world's ideological future was bound to end in bloodshed.
This conflict was inevitable. Our ideological differences practically guaranteed war.
There are others who defy our ideological views, yet you attack me? Truly you have lost your way, old friend.
You have betrayed your word. Make no mistake, the world will know of your treachery.
Your treachery shall not be forgotten.
Your actions fill me with sadness... There is surely a special place in Hell for those such as you.
You would attack us in such a manner? Your hubris knows no limits. I hope that you will one day be judged for this.
Taking advantage of another's weakness is unnecessary in the pursuit of victory. Surely you know there's a better way?
How could you do such a thing? Begone, you vile being.
My people wail in horror at this decision. Why?
What have I done to deserve this?
We could have been allies, yet you chose the path of violence. A pity.
Haha. Well, I won't question your decision, but it appears to me that you've made a big mistake.
You have played right into my trap. Prepare to be slaughtered.
You didn't really think this through, did you?
Do you really think that you can defeat me? Fool. Very well. Let us play this game then.
You have condemned your people to defeat.
That was the last mistake you will ever make.
I have been looking forward to this.
Your armies are welcome to come and enjoy the destruction that will befall them.
Attacking me was a mistake. I will soon show you why.
Declaring war was a serious error in judgment on your part. That having been said, I will not hesitate to make you regret it.
I will not hesitate to punish you for making such a foolish move.
Good. Let us do this. It gives me an excellent opportunity to finally destroy you.
You wretched fool. I will now mercilessly crush you.
This is going to be fun.
The foolish warmonger stirs the sleeping dragon. You have bit off more than you can chew.
This war will test both of our empires. Others may have fallen to your sword, but your campaign of violence ends here.
While now may not be the ideal moment for us to cross swords, the opportunity to take you down a notch or two is worth it.
I laugh in the face of death, even if I stand alone!
This will be my moment of triumph.
I may fail to overcome your evil, but it won't be for lack of effort.
Given the circumstances, destroying you would make victory all the sweeter.
Destroy me if you can. I can promise you though, I will not fall before you easily.
So be it. My armies will fight to the death against your wicked forces.
You will forever be known as a villain who preys on the weak.
You are strong, but you lack conviction. I shall seize the day.
Your hubris will be your downfall.
You are misled if you think you can defeat me.
My armies will not be so easily defeated.
We may lack your military strength; however, I would rather die a noble death than be a bloody tyrant like you.
It is clear to all that you are a wise and mighty ruler. I ask that you might also be compassionate towards those like myself who are weak.
Oh great one, my hope is that you will long serve as a paragon of strength and virtue for lesser leaders such as myself.
Your power and majesty are unparalleled. I hope to one day become a powerful ruler like you.
I must admit that I both admire and fear your great power. You are an example to us all.
I am willing to overlook your recent espionage activites in my lands if you make a solemn promise that it will not happen again.
As a friend, I am willing to forgive you for spying on me... this time.
How did your wretched spies get through my defenses? These may be the last words we speak in peace.
Your agents escaped my grasp this time, but they shall not be so lucky in the future. You shall tempt fate if you dare to spy on me again.
Your message of strength through supreme power has resonated with our people. Must we imitate your feared totalitarian state?
My people speak of a 'third way' that promises great reward and even greater glory. Must all empires glorify the sword, as yours does?
The people of my nation have been corrupted by your bourgeois messages of liberty and equality. They seem to believe they have the right to demonstrate in the streets!
My people demand that I grant them a constitution, civil liberties, and even the right to vote! This is your doing, isn't it?
Your ideological plotting has us scared of a revolution for Order in our land. Will these workers' strikes never end?
The workers in my cities refer to themselves as members of the proletariat, and speak of global revolution! Must we all reject the trappings of property and statism like you?
Your restless people are in need of strong leadership. Join us in writing history instead of sitting there with your hands folded.
The insatiable lust for war stirs in the hearts of your people. Embrace the warrior's spirit, lest I be required to force it upon you by the sword.
Your citizens clamor for human liberties. Tear down this wall of oppression and join the cause of Freedom and progress!
The clarion call of freedom cannot be silenced by your oppressive regime. Grant liberties to your people, so that we may all prosper under the banner of Freedom.
The oppressed workers of your land are unhappy. Whether you like it or not, history is on our side. We will bury you!
Your ideology will soon be thrown upon the dust heap of history. Join the worker's revolution, or be trampled by it.
I have no idea what you are up to, or what kind of mark you are trying to make on history, but know this: we're watching you, and we have our own plans.
One of my historians came by the other day to ask me about you and your impact on world history. Do you want to know what I told him? Nothing, because you have done nothing of note.
I received a shipment of your so-called 'cultural artifacts' the other day. How quaint. You will all soon know the meaning of true culture.
There is only room for one cultural conqueror on this planet. Prepare to be enlightened.
Though we both stare into the night sky and dream of interstellar empire, historians will remember only one of us for being the first to accomplish such a great task: me.
We shall soon slip the surly bonds of Earth and pierce the heavens in our shiny new rockets. I'm sorry, by 'we' I meant my people, not yours.
You will soon bend your knee to my silver-tongued diplomats. Global hegemony shall be mine!
You'll be happy to know that I've just finished revising my acceptance speech for the position of 'Supreme Leader of Earth.' I do hope you'll attend the reception.
This world is not big enough for two would-be conquerors. My armies will meet yours on the battlefield soon enough. Prepare yourself!
Do you hear the footsteps of my armies? Fear me, and fear them, as there cannot be two world conquerors on this day. Your army stands in my way, but not for long.
I wanted to make it known to you that I value our friendship, and hope that it might remain strong.
Hello there. Are you here about that little spying incident?
Greetings! Let's not discuss petty things like spying, or the fact that you caught one of my spies... please?
That is an intriguing offer. I accept. However, my empire is not yet prepared, so give me 10 turns. I will come to you again when I am ready.
War, you say? Give me 10 turns to muster my troops.
That sounds like a wise move. Let us take to the battlefield.
My soldiers are excited at the prospect of war. To arms, ally!
How dare you? Know that there will be consequences for this.
If you are trying to provoke a war, you're doing a fine job.
What a brazen act of theft. The world will hear of this.
{2_MajorCivName:textkey} has taken back its guarantee of protecting {1_MinorCivName:textkey}.

{2_MajorCivName:textkey} announces to the world that it is now protecting {1_MinorCivName:textkey}. Attacking the City-State or demanding tribute from it will greatly damage relations and may lead to war.
Sorry, but no. Perhaps another time.
I fear that such an arrangement is not in my best interests, so I must decline.
Sorry, but the answer is no.
I do not see the value of that agreement, so no, I think not.
You have something I want. If you don't hand it over quietly, I'll have no choice but to take it by force.
No offense, but you have something I want, and I'm fairly certain that I can take it from you.
Unacceptable. I am a sovereign and have the right to settle what lands I please. This offense will not be forgotten.
You dare insult me in such a manner? I will not forget this.
How dare you? Do you believe me to be weak-willed?
Not a chance. You need to brush up on your diplomacy, my friend.
You are foolish to think that you can tell me what to do.
I settle where I please, when I please. The answer is no.
No way. I have plans for that territory.
Impossible. My people need that land.
Very well. I agree to avoid settling in the vicinity of your empire for the time being. Perhaps in the future you will be a more accommodating neighbor.
So be it. I will not settle near your lands. Cooperation is clearly not one of your strong suits.
I promise not to settle near your lands. For now.
I will not settle near your lands, but only because you asked nicely.
Although feigning friendship with you wasn't very polite, few who make their mark on history were known for their manners. May your passage be swift.
Your weakness is my opportunity. Placing any trust in me was a mistake.
Backstab is such an ugly word. Shall we instead say I am just "reinterpreting" our supposed friendship?
I have to admit, I never really liked you much. Pretending to do so was getting old anyways. But enough with the small talk, it's time for you to die.
You should have seen this coming. You didn't? I almost feel bad. Almost.
I was never your friend. Consider this a lesson in politics.
Come now, don't be upset. This is only betrayal if you are a fool.
I felt a little guilty leading you on like that, but the reward will be oh so sweet.
Although the task before me may be impossible, I am compelled to find a way to destroy you and all that you stand for. I will do so or die trying.
Your strength does not compensate for your wickedness.
If I am to die, I will die with dignity. You wouldn't understand.
For those who are about to die, I salute you.
Today is a good day to die.
This war will serve as a clarion call to those who can, and will, defeat you.
Fortune favors the bold, not the strong.
History honors the brave, not the wicked. You shall be nothing but a footnote.
It is clear that you are strong. I will, however, find a way to defeat you.
You are a villain without equal. Within every fiber of my being, I know I must destroy you.
Your might is unmatched, but I will find a way to defeat you.
The time to make a stand is now. The odds are not with me, but I find a way to destroy you.
Your incredible strength will not deter me from finding a way to defeat you. May the fates smile on me.
Although I do not wish it, I fear that now may be my only opportunity to defeat you. Let us meet on the battlefield.
Destruction might be the fate which awaits me, but should I back down, only eventual defeat awaits anyway.
I will die before I give in to your tyranny.
It is clear that our two empires will never see eye to eye. This is something that can only be settled on the battlefield.
I had a feeling that the two of us would someday meet in the field of battle. We will now see which of us is meant to be victorious.
It is time to fight. May the best of us win.
War is the only solution to our current disagreements.
The time for diplomacy is over. I bring war to your doorstep.
This Cold War has gone on long enough. Let us settle this ideological dispute once and for all.
Your ideological values have no place in this world. I shall soon destroy you.
Though you profess to believe in the same values as I, your actions betray you. I shall scour you from the earth, false friend.
We may share an ideology, but even that is not enough to keep me from hating you. You will be destroyed soon enough.
Our proximity has fated us to be enemies. Let us see which of us is fit to survive in this land.
You are too close for comfort. My empire requires more living space.
Your lands will make a fine addition to my own.
My empire needs more land. Your land, to be precise.
It is unfortunate for you that we are neighbors.
Your lands shall soon be mine!
Once more our armies shall meet on the battlefield. We might have been friends once, but there is too much bad blood now for that.
Ah yes, our oldest enemy. I look forward to clashing with you once again.
The advantage is mine. I will now destroy you.
There's no use in hiding it any more: I seek to destroy you.
The day of your defeat is nigh!
You shall be but a footnote of history.
Your defeat is inevitable. Surrender now, or else.
Your armies will be wiped clean from the face of the earth.
I saw an opportunity, and I have taken it. Don't take it personally.
You are weak, and I am strong. This was inevitable.
I have waited long enough. I have seen an opening in your defense and I will use it to my advantage.
I have been waiting a long time for this day. Now would be a good time to put your affairs in order.
It is now my time. I will defeat you and come one step closer to victory.
Fate is not on your side. Crossing my path with such weakness is a mistake you will not long regret.
The current situation cannot be ignored. It is now or never.
I cannot ignore this chance to eliminate a potential competitor.
Your weakness presents to me a great opportunity. You have my apologies.
You have played right into my trap.
I believe in another life the two of us could have been friends. Unfortunately, that is not how it is now. I wish your armies luck.
My friend, I fear that I have no choice but to break our ties and draw my sword. I hope that you might one day forgive me for this.
I can hardly believe that it's come to this, but yes, this is indeed happening. It is with great sorrow that I must inform you that our friendship must come to an end.
Enough is enough. Someone has to stop your bloody rampage soon, and it might as well be me.
It falls to me to prevent the world from succumbing to a new dark age.
The odds are clearly not with me, but I see no alternative to revealing my deceptive practices. I can now only pray that my armies succeed.
I see no choice but to fight you. I am sorry that it must end like this.
This world is destined to be mine. It is time for me to show you what that means.
There can be only one leader on this planet... and it will be me.
Fate has christened me the one which shall bring unity to this divided planet.
History shall surely smile on me once I've destroyed the likes of you and the rest of the vermin which surround me.
I'll be honest with you - I intend to destroy you along with everyone else.
You are merely a stepping-stone on my grand ascent to world domination.
Now is the time for my master plan to commence. It is time for you to die like the rest of these fools.
There is not room on this planet for both of us.
Mine shall be an empire to circle the globe!
We should consider exchanging embassies, which would allow for more advanced diplomacy between our peoples.
The relationship between our empires can only get better with time. Shall we exchange embassies to accelerate this process?
We should exchange embassies as a sign of goodwill.
We would like to set up an embassy in your capital. What do you think?
I am interested in establishing an embassy in your capital. Does this arrangement suit you?
We would like to set up an embassy in your capital. Will you agree to this request?
The sharing of embassies will faciliate greater cooperation between our peoples. Do you agree?
Friend, please accept this offer as a gesture of gratitude for our friendship.
In your time of need I offer you a gift.
To show our support of our friendship, I offer your people this in hopes you will one day return the favor.
Please accept this gift, great leader. May our friendship last forever.
Friends must support one another to overcome the challenges this world poses. Please accept this gift, great leader.
While I have this opportunity, I should mention that your expansion has worried several of my officials. I hope that this does not cause any problems in the future. What would you like to discuss?
While I agree that all empires have a right to expand, you have taken too much, far too quickly. For the sake of peace, please curtail your reckless expansion.
The positioning of your military is somewhat worrisome. I advise you to withdraw for the sake of future peace. Now, what would you like to talk about?
I wish for peace, but your posturing makes me fear that war is on the horizon. Is it?

Your recent trend of buying land near us is concerning. For the sake of our future relationship, I advise that you be cautious in this matter. Now that that's out of the way, what brings you here today?
Must you buy EVERY good piece of land you see?
What's the matter? Tired of battle?
Here to beg for mercy, perhaps?
Are you here to admit defeat?
Is it not time we ended this war?
For the good of our two nations, let us make peace.
The time has come to put down our arms.
This war has gone on long enough, don't you think?
Too many of our bravest have perished in this conflict. Let us make peace.
The day of peace is nigh. Come, let us embrace it.
What business does a dishonorable individual such as yourself have here?
Why would a backstabber such as yourself come back here?
It won't be long before we'll have dealt with {1_ThirdPlayerName:textkey}. I can just feel it.
I hope you're looking forward to the downfall of {1_ThirdPlayerName:textkey} as much as I am.
Soon we'll have dealt with {1_ThirdPlayerName:textkey} once and for all.
{1_ThirdPlayerName:textkey} is staring defeat in the face, thanks to our combined efforts.
When {1_ThirdPlayerName:textkey} is gone, who shall we fight against next?
Oh, okay. So now you want to talk, huh?
Showing your face here after the things you've said? State your purpose quickly before I throw you out.
You? What do you want? I have no more business with the likes of you.
And what do you think you're doing here?
Ah, greetings. Always happy to speak with other leaders who share my dislike of {1_PlayerName}.
Oh, it's you. I'll be honest with you, I don't take kindly towards those who insult {1_PlayerName}.
The end is near. What is it you wish to speak about?
I know when I'm staring defeat in the face. Have you come to discuss terms?
My soldiers have lost the will to fight. Can I convince you to show them mercy?
It seems I've lost both the battle and the war. Can't we come to some sort of agreement?
Your empire is famed for its strong economy. Perhaps one day you might be willing to share some of your secrets with a friend?
Your caravans and cargo ships dominate the world's trade unlike anything I've ever seen before. Truly an impressive sight.
Your people are wealthy and prosperous, and they have your wise leadership to thank for it.
I've heard many stories of your powerful military. The villains of this world would be wise to fear your might.
Your empire is quite powerful. I do hope that you plan to only use such power for good.
Your military is terrifying. I am glad to be on your good side.
The spread of your cities and people is like a plague infecting the land. I look forward to the day I don't have to see it anymore.
You have greedily taken far more land than is rightfully yours. You will pay for this greed soon.
I see your military forces near my borders. Are you here to foolishly threaten me or are you simply wasting my time?
Too many of your troops linger near our mutual border. Pull them back, unless you mean war.
Your theft of all the territory in your empire showcases your greed. You know that will catch up with you eventually, right?
You spend gold to steal land while I spend gold to buy brand new weapons for my soldiers. Who do you think will benefit the most from their investment in the long run?
You are brave, showing your face here.
What business do you have here?
Go ahead, spit it out already.
How's your little war going? Hopefully not too well. What do you want?
I would wish you good luck in your current conflict, but that would be a lie.
The puny one makes an appearance. We were just talking about you. Only bad things, I assure you.
I'm surprised to see you here. Shouldn't you be out settling new cities or something?
Ah, the bloodthirsty one shows his face. And what business does he have with me?
Your arrogance shall be your downfall, warmonger.
Just between you and me, your military is kind of the laughing stock of the world. Don't let that get you down though; I'm sure someone will put you out of your misery soon.
I think I saw your only soldiers walking around the other day. They looked sad and lonely. Perhaps you should train a few friends for them?
You must have something better to do than talk to me all the time. Or maybe you don't.
And what do you want this time?
Looking for a handout or something?
Oh look, my little pet state has come to see me. What do you want?
Your men had better be hard at work creating resources to please me. What do you want?
You stand in the presence of your superior. Kneel before me, or else.
Best of luck in your current conflict. What can I do for you?
My people and I are hopeful that your current war is going well.
What brings you here today? Business, or pleasure?
What would you like to discuss?
What is it? I don't have much time for those who hang around with the likes of {1_PlayerName}.
Ah, hello. Always happy to talk with a friend of {1_PlayerName}.
Hello, friend. What brings you to my court this day?
It's always a pleasure speaking with you. What would you like to discuss?
Great to see you again. Do you come with news, or perhaps an offer?
Hail, friend. What can I do for you?
Speak, friend, and enter... my throne room.
Welcome, friend. Shall I prepare a feast to mark this occasion?
You sure do like talking to me, don't you?
Don't you have an empire to run?
Greetings. How goes progress towards the Research Agreement?
What's this? A visit from my vassal? Is it tribute you offer?
Ah, one of my many servants? What do you have to offer?
I promise that my soldiers shall protect you and your land. What do you want?
Welcome, master, to my lands. How may I be of service?
Greetings! I hope you're pleased to know our workers are hard at work producing resources for your use.
Ah, welcome master! What assistance do you seek from us?
Your enslavement of my people brings embarrassment to all of us. What do you want?
Oh, the tyrant shows his face again. How do you wish to exploit us further?
Oh? What brings the tyrant to my doorstep? Have you come to spit on us and our pride further?
We are eagerly anticipating your unconditional surrender.
We can make a deal now to forestall your utter annihilation.
I assume you are here to admit defeat?
Your destruction is complete. Admit it.
Why do you still fight? The war is over.
The villain {1_ThirdPlayerName:textkey} remains a constant headache. Don't you agree?
Greetings. My hope is that it is not long before we can finally deal with {1_ThirdPlayerName:textkey} once and for all.
Any new plans for how to deal with {1_ThirdPlayerName:textkey}?
Always a pleasure working with you, friend. What brings you to my court?
I'm sorry. My generosity does not extend as far as you'd like, I'm afraid.
You have asked for simply too much, I'm afraid. I cannot comply.
Absolutely not. I am a generous person, but that is too much you are asking me to give up.
I'm sorry, but I've already offered as much assistance as I can at this time. Maybe some other time.
It's been too soon since our last show of generosity. I'm afraid I must decline.
I cannot service this request at the moment. I'm sorry.
May this gift bring prosperity to your people.
It is my pleasure to assist those in need.
Well, at least you're honest. But that may be your only good trait.
I knew this day would come.
So it is. We are prepared for war. Are you?
Why do you continue to waste my time with this nonsense? Begone!
Did you not hear me the first time? Go away!
I'm sorry, are you hard of hearing? The answer will always be no!
We would never share our diplomatic secrets with villains like you!
Do you honestly think I would tell a criminal like you my foreign policy?
Why would you waste your time asking about my foreign affairs? They are none of your business!
I'm not surprised you said that.
Very well. I'll be monitoring the situation.
I hope your actions do not betray your words.
Very well. I'll be monitoring the situation.
We shall see if your actions mirror your words.
Your indiscretion is not a surprise.
You are nothing but a thieving coward.
I am glad you agreed to stop spying on my people.
I hope that this circumstance serves as a lesson to you.
You dare insult me in such a manner? If you want something so badly, then do your best to come and take it.
You'll have to take it from my dead body.
If you want that, you'll have to come and get it.
You will get nothing from me, tyrant.
You must be joking. No way.
Ha! You'll need to defeat {1_CivName} before extracting such concessions from me.
We are protected by {1_CivName}. Take your avaricious pleas to them.
Your greed knows no bounds. Thankfully, {1_CivName} will protect us from you.
You ask for too much. I will not drive my nation into poverty to satisfy your greed.
No. I have my dignity, and refuse to hand over such a great bounty so freely.
Your desire to strip my lands of so much wealth is intolerable. Do not ask for so much.
Your demands are too great. I cannot agree to them.
I will not cave to your greed. The answer is no.
Do you think I am a pushover? I will give you nothing.
You threaten me again so soon? I refuse your demands, you vile beast.
Asking again so soon? You know that greed is a vice, great leader...
Asking for the fruits of others' labor yet again? Your greed is legendary. I will not give in to you.
This barrage of insane demands can only lead to war.
You are a barbaric and greedy person, did you know that?
You are an avaricious knave. I will give you nothing.
Please. You're in no position to make such demands.
You should be well aware of your own inability to back those threats up.
You're not fooling anyone. I have nothing to fear from you.
Haha! You are not strong enough to make such demands of me.
No way. You are weak and lack the force to make such demands.
You and I both know you can't enforce that demand.
You are a fool if you think I'll give you anything for free.
Not a chance. Perhaps you should try such tactics on someone less capable than I.
Very well. I do what I must to maintain peace in my lands.
I will do what it takes to keep the peace.
Fine. But know that you poison your reputation with acts such as these. For what that might be worth to you.
I will acquiesce to your demands, this time.
You ask for too much, but I must accept.
Your demands are harsh, but I cannot refuse. Our relationship will suffer as a result of this.
Excellent. I hope that we can continue to find common ground.
I hope that this is the last time we have to discuss this.
Your delegation played a part in the failure of our proposal to the {1_LeagueName}. I do not take such transgressions lightly.
Our proposal to the {1_LeagueName} was defeated at the hands of your delegates. Do not expect our delegation to support your interests in the future.
You foiled our proposal to the {1_LeagueName}. I'll make you pay for this.
I just learned that you are largely to blame for the failure of our proposal to the {1_LeagueName}. You are a terrible person.
Excellent. I hope that we can continue to find common ground.
I'm glad this won't become an issue.
It seems that you cannot be reasoned with. What a shame.
I have no more business with the likes of you, then.
You know that this can only sow tension between our two nations.
You isolate yourself with such statements.
I have nothing else to say to you.
How can you be so brazenly foolish?
I am saddened by your decision.
I am pleased to hear this.
You are truly a great leader.
History will long remember your great deeds.
You have made a wise choice.
This will end in nothing short of violence, I assure you.
I'm glad you agreed to end this proselytizing.
You have made a wise choice, and my people thank you for it.
We thank you for entrusting the World Congress to our capable leadership. I expect great things to come in the {1_LeagueName}.
We are the host of the {1_LeagueName} thanks to you. I promise to do my best to support your proposals in the future.
The {1_LeagueName} is under our control because of wise leaders like you. Together, we can make the world a better place.
Thanks to the help of your delegates, our recent proposal to the {1_LeagueName} was successful. We look forward to your continued support, and will try to return the favor.
Our proposal to the {1_LeagueName} succeeded, with the support of your delegation. Together we can accomplish many great things.
Your support of our proposal to the {1_LeagueName} was essential. I hope we can work together again in the future.
You made a wise choice, supporting our proposal to the {1_LeagueName}. My people are indebted to you.
Our people are now buying your blue jeans and listening to your pop music. I worry the rest of the world will also succumb to the influence of your culture.
We are glad to see that sales of our souvenirs to tourists from your lands have reached record levels. The amazing works of our civilization are truly inspiring!
Your culture has overawed my coarse and barbaric people. Our culture will be ground to dust under the weight of your mighty influence, however others surely remain who will contest your dominance.
We were once a proud, independent culture, but now all that remains of our former glory rests on dusty shelves. Someday you too will join us in the archives of history ... but today is not that day.

I lament that the traditions of my ancestors are being swept away by the powerful force of your influence. Is this the beginning of an age of cultural darkness, or are you the bringer of enlightenment?

I am happy to see that you have finally abandoned your miserable, barbaric customs. Do not despair, as it is far better for a culture to die by choice than by the sword ... though yours, perhaps, may succumb to both.

There is little space now for the diverse traditions of bygone eras. Unfortunately for you, it seems that your culture has been pushed out. Don't worry, I plan on dedicating a large section of our new antiquities museum to you.
Do not fear the new way of life that has enthralled your people. You will soon forget all about the backwards and rude traditions you laughably called 'culture.'
It's a shame there are some leaders in this world who have their fun by picking on the weak. Don't you agree?
Harassing the weak simply shows the world how petty and miserable you really are.
You are a bully, and bullies always end up on the dust heap of history.
It's come to my attention that your empire appears to be quite puny. Did you forget to expand your borders or are you just having a little trouble with that?
The size of your empire is worrisome. Are you trying to be a city-state or something?
You really need to expand, if only so that there are more cities in the world for me to conquer.
What a sad sight... your empire is so uncultured. What do your citizens do all day, beat rocks together?
Rumor has it that your culture is so laughable that even the barbarians are shying away from your lands.
You are barbaric and crude. Shall I send one of my artists over to show you what real culture looks like?
Your culture is the embodiment of darkness and solitude. And no, that isn't a compliment.
I've met barbarians that are more cultured than you.
I couldn't help but notice how pathetic you are. And when I realized it, I couldn't help but share.
Ah, it's always nice to see my favorite city-state again.
I'm really getting tired of seeing your face. My hope is that one day you'll just go away or something.
Ah, it's you. My apologies. Sometimes I get you mixed up with the barbarians I have to swat from time to time.
You are a cruel and miserable person.
I would compare you to a city-state, but at least city-states have integrity.
You are like a bad dream that simply won't go away.
I'm surprised someone hasn't wiped you off the map yet. A pity.
I thought you might like to know that your army is a little on the weak side. Better watch your back.
With an army as weak as yours, it's a surprise your empire hasn't succumb to a barbarian invasion.
The weakness of your army is an embarrassment matched only by your pathetic leadership.
Your walls will do you no good if you have no soldiers to defend them.
You have far too much faith in the goodwill of your neighbors. Your lack of an army makes you a juicy target.
Our words are backed with nuclear weapons!
We have the bomb, and we are not afraid to use it!
Travelers have told us that your empire's economy is in pretty sad shape. If you beg a little, I might give you a hand. Okay, actually, I won't.
Your economy is the laughing stock of the world. Do you need some help or something?
When I look at your pathetic economy, it makes me sad. I'd help, but I'm too busy being rich and powerful.
I can hear your people wailing in sorrow all the way over in my empire. If you don't do something soon, they might just pack up and find a real civilization to live in.
With your people so unhappy, it's a shock to me that they'd keep you around as their leader.
The amount of human misery in your empire is appalling. I might have to come over there and show your people what real leadership looks like.
Are really that bad of a leader, or are you simply cruel? How barbaric.
I regret any confusion caused by our late agent's recent activity. Please let any hostile feelings rest with the deceased operative.
It is good that you captured and killed that rogue spy who claimed to be working for me. Wait, you don't believe me that he was rogue? Well, that's just foolish of you.
We killed your spy as it was trying to steal from us. From my experience, it is far less dangerous to read a book and try to learn something yourself.
I hope your spy's death has taught you a valuable lesson about thievery. If not, go ahead and send another of your spies this way... we have plenty of ammunition.
What did you have in mind?
You have a Luxury Resource that I would like. What do you think of this offer?
Let us trade. You have a Luxury Resource that I would like.
My people have expressed interest in one of your Luxury Resources. Shall we trade?
You have a fine assortment of Luxury Resources. Shall we make a deal?
You have a Luxury Resource that my people want. On their behalf, let's trade, shall we?
We'd like to purchase your world map from you. Will you accept?

It's come to my attention that you're getting a little friendly with {1_MinorCivName:textkey}. In case you weren't aware, they're within my sphere of influence, and I'd prefer if you stayed out of it.
I've noticed your relationship with {1_MinorCivName:textkey}. While that's nice, it would be best that you leave their protection to us. I'd hate for either of us to step on any toes.
Your relationship with {1_MinorCivName:textkey} is intolerable. Send your diplomats elsewhere, or face the consequences.
{1_MinorCivName:textkey} told me recently that they think you are a foul and terrible person. Perhaps you should focus on a different city-state, and leave this one to me?
I see that you are friends with {1_MinorCivName:textkey}. So am I. This is quite awkward, is it not? You should probably leave them alone.
I found {1_MinorCivName:textkey} first, therefore I have the right to work with them, not you. Can't you find a different city-state to lay claim to?
As you wish, I shall move my troops from your border. My apologies for any trouble caused by this incident.
Very well, I will redirect my armies elsewhere.
Understood. I will move my troops at once.
Please understand, my troops are merely passing through! We mean no harm to your empire.
Don't be alarmed. We do not wish to harm you. Our troops are merely running drills.
I apologize for any concern my recent troop movements have caused you. Our troops are merely passing through the area and we have no intention of war.
Maybe you're smarter than I thought. Perhaps you expected my eventual rise to world domination? Or maybe you're just stupid. Either way, time to die.
Honestly, there's no sense lying to you. You are merely a stepping stone to my ascent to greatness.
Ha! That's not the way I expect you to talk to your future ruler. Now, you must suffer.
I'll admit, at some point I thought you were a pretty good friend. However, it's time to show my true colors. My troops are aimed directly at your cities. Time to die.
What's this? Are you just trying to egg me on? Well, consider yourself lucky; you've succeeded. Prepare to die.
There can be no peace. Perhaps another day.
This is not the time for negotiation.
We still have business to settle.
The time for diplomacy is long gone.
I believe it's in our mutual interest to allow free passage between our two great empires.
Opening our borders to one another can only serve to solidify our friendship.
Let us open our borders to one another. We have nothing to fear from each other, right?
Come, let us open our borders as a sign of goodwill and faith.
I would like to negotiate passage through your territory.
An open borders agreement would benefit us both.
Will you allow my troops to enter your lands?
I need to cross your borders. Will you agree to this?
Please consider my request for open borders.
Our words are backed with nuclear weapons!
I am happy to see an end to this conflict.
It is good to see the end of this terrible war.
Let us celebrate peace in our time.
I hope this is the last war we fight.
The time has come to end this war. What do you think of this arrangement?
There is no point in this conflict continuing any further. Let us return to peace.
We must not let war define who we are. The time has come to make peace.
This war must end sooner or later. How does this agreement look?
I am tired of battle. Come, let us settle this in the boardroom, instead of on the battlefield.
Let us end this war, as it is ruining us both. Would you agree to this?
What is the price of peace?
What will it take to end this war?

I would like to lay plans for establishing a Research Agreement with your great nation. Doing so would require each of us to spend 150 [ICON_GOLD]. What do you think?[NEWLINE][NEWLINE](Agreeing will not form a Research Agreement yet)
This deal strengthened our nations and our bonds of friendship. Shall we renew this deal and continue our shared prosperity?
Cooperation and proper diplomacy are the hallmarks of civilization. Shall we continue to be an example to the rest of the world?
This was a fine deal, and my advisors and I would be sad to see it end. Shall we renew this agreement?
We have both prospered greatly as a result of this deal. Shall we renew it?
It is time to renew this deal. Shall we?
I hope that you have benefited from this deal as much as I have. Do you want to continue this arrangement?
We've been over this before. The answer is still no.
I will not field such requests at this time. Please stop asking.
We've been over this before. I will not tell you of my affairs.
The answer remains no. We shall not provide diplomatic details at this time.
Didn't I already say you would have to do better?
I already told you to only bother offering a fair deal.
Are you offering deals you know I won't accept?
Come, now, you can do better than that.
This isn't going to work if you keep trying to trick me.
Are you trying to insult me?
Unfortunately, things aren't going terribly well over here. Can you spare something for a friend? I'll try to return the favor when things are going better for me.
Although it pains me to do so, I must ask for your assistance, friend.
Your great strength is a model for all other empires. I ask that you show generosity towards those less fortunate.
I have fallen on hard times, and I could use some help. Can you spare this, friend?
I have nowhere else to turn. Could you give this to me, as a friend?
My people need assistance, and they look to you. Surely you cannot deny them this help?
I feel that a Research Agreement is a mutually beneficial arrangement that would help serve to cement our friendship.
{1_PlayerName} attempted to persuade us to start a cooperative war against you. I hope my rejection of their offer pleases you.
While {1_PlayerName} is my friend, I just told them their plan for a joint war against you was unacceptable. Beware their intentions!
It makes me glad that you will overlook this awkward circumstance.
I am glad we can put this nonsense behind us.
I am relieved that you are not upset.
I understand that some actions may not be forgiven.
It saddens me that this mistake has permanently scarred our relationship.
I must admit, I knew you would feel that way.
As you wish, our missionaries will no longer share the one true faith with the people in your cities.
We will spread our beliefs elsewhere, though I still believe I was doing your people a favor.
In spite of your protests, your citizens will continue to be enlightened by our missionaries, even though you damn your own people to live in ignorance.
Our faith warns us against idolaters such as you. We will not rest until you and your people follow the one true religion.
Do I have to escalate this?
Watch yourself. Wars have been fought over less.
Thank you for heeding our request. An artifact discovered on our land belongs to our people, not yours.
Your decision is the right one. If you really want to see our artifacts, come visit our museums instead of trying to steal them from us.
Our spies have uncovered that {1_PlayerName} embarked an army with naval escorts to sneak attack your city of {2_CityName}. We hope that you will share any intrigue your agents discover with us.
{1_PlayerName} is preparing a naval invasion of your city of {2_CityName}. I hope this warning arrives in time for you to put it to good use.
Our spies have uncovered that {1_PlayerName} embarked an army with naval escorts in a sneak attack against your civilization. We hope that you will share any intrigue your agents discover with us.
{1_PlayerName} is preparing for a naval sneak attack against you. I am sorry that I could not uncover more information than this.
Our spies have uncovered that {1_PlayerName} is currently marching an army to sneak attack your city of {2_CityName}. We hope that you will share any intrigue your agents discover with us.
I recently learned that {1_PlayerName} has an army headed towards your city of {2_CityName}. Consider this warning a favor, one that I hope you will one day return.
Our spies have uncovered that {1_PlayerName} is currently marching an army your way in a sneak attack. We hope that you will share any intrigue your agents discover with us.
Prepare yourself! {1_PlayerName} is about to launch a sneak attack against you! If anyone is planning the same for us, I do hope you will let us know.
Our spies have uncovered that {1_PlayerName} has bribed {2_PlayerName} to go to war with you. We hope that you will share any intrigue your agents discover with us.
Our spies have uncovered that {1_PlayerName} and {2_PlayerName} are preparing to go to war with you. We hope that you will share any intrigue your agents discover with us.
Our spies have uncovered that {1_PlayerName} is plotting against you. We hope that you will share any intrigue your agents discover with us.
I thought you would like to know that {1_PlayerName} is plotting against you. I always knew they were up to no good.
{1_PlayerName} is plotting against you. I hope this warning does not arrive too late.
We've noticed that you've been looking for cultural artifacts within our borders. This needs to stop.
As you wish, we will stop looking for artifacts within your borders.
It pains me to do so, but I will send my archaeologists elsewhere. A pity, as I just finished building a Museum to house your artifacts.
Sorry, our plans are too important to be stopped over a trinket.
There is nothing you can do to stop me. The world's artifacts belong to me!
Our agents help keep our civilization safe from all threats, including you. They operate as we need them to, not as you ask.
I know you are hiding something dreadful, and my spies will not stop until I uncover it.
As you request, our agents will not conduct operations in your territory.
Fine, I'll send my spies elsewhere. There is not much to learn from you, anyway.
As you wish, I will make sure that all my spies are informed to ignore your empire for the time being.
Your subject nations cry out for independence. Can you hear it? Come, what will it cost to get you to listen?
I beg of you, please release your vassals. Is this offer tempting enough?
Independence is a natural right. Come, let us restore balance by coming to an agreement for the sake of your vassals.
Thank you for bringing this {@1_CivAdjective} plot to our attention. With this warning, we will be ready for whatever they may try. Your generous aid will be remembered.
This {@1_CivAdjective} plot will fail, thanks to you. My people will hear of your good deed.
For freeing those captives, you have my thanks.
I am appreciative for the actions you have taken on behalf of my people.
Thank you. May this be remembered as a historic event which brought our two great empires closer together.
Thank you for returning our citizens.
You are a wise leader. My people sing your praises.
You have returned my citizens, and for that I am eternally grateful.
Welcome great emperor! I'm pleased to see you have also chosen to follow the path of Autocracy. May we work together to ensure that only the very strongest nations survive to achieve true greatness!
Greetings, fellow warlord! Our mutual decision shall decide the future of humanity: it shall be either our view or theirs, as there can be no compromises!

Warm salutations to you wise leader! I'm pleased to see you also have chosen to follow the path of Freedom. The free world will be stronger with one more nation to help us all fight against oppression!
Hail, citizen! The path of Freedom lies before us, and none shall stand in our path. Let the darkness of the world tremble before the light of liberty!
Greetings comrade! I'm pleased to see you also have chosen to follow the path of Order. Perhaps we can find some opportunities to aid each other during our empires' next 5-Year Plans!
Let others tremble at our shared belief in Order. We have nothing to lose but our chains. We have a world to win. Workers of the world, unite!
I look up to {1_PlayerName:textkey} with great envy! (Afraid)
Hopefully one day I can be as good a leader as {1_PlayerName:textkey}. (Afraid)
It may appear that I am friendly with {1_PlayerName:textkey} but that's all show. (Deceptive)
Think you can keep a secret? I plan on deceiving {1_PlayerName:textkey} at earliest convenience. (Deceptive)
I tell the world that {1_PlayerName:textkey} is a friend. I tell you in strictest confidence that that is not the case. (Deceptive)
{1_PlayerName:textkey} is a true friend and can be trusted. (Friendly)
I'm quite fond of {1_PlayerName:textkey} and look forward to our continued friendship. (Friendly)
{1_PlayerName:textkey} and I have been on good terms, and I see no reason why that would change. (Friendly)
I'll be honest. I don't trust {1_PlayerName:textkey} one bit. (Guarded)
{1_PlayerName:textkey} has alarmed my advisors and we are monitoring the situation. (Guarded)
We're keeping an eye on {1_PlayerName:textkey} due to recent incidents. (Guarded)
{1_PlayerName:textkey}'s rule taints this earth and I would see no problem with it ending. (Hostile)
{1_PlayerName:textkey} is a tyrant and a villain that needs to be taken care of. (Hostile)
Don't remind me that {1_PlayerName:textkey} still walks this earth... (Hostile)
I really don't have an opinion of {1_PlayerName:textkey}. (Neutral)
{1_PlayerName:textkey} is neither an enemy of mine nor my friend. (Neutral)
I'm sorry, but we prefer to keep our diplomatic secrets safe. Try again some other time.
My advisors deem it important to keep our foreign policy private. Maybe some other time?
We're not comfortable broadcasting our foreign affairs at this time. Perhaps another time?
I trust you enough to confess that I am planning war against {1_PlayerName:textkey}. (Planning War!)
Don't be fooled by outward appearances. I plan to rid this earth of {1_PlayerName:textkey}. (Planning War!)
I'm sick of {1_PlayerName:textkey}'s presence and I plan on eliminating them soon. (Planning War!)
{1_PlayerName:textkey} and I are at war! ([COLOR_NEGATIVE_TEXT]AT WAR![ENDCOLOR])
{1_PlayerName:textkey} and I are locked in combat. ([COLOR_NEGATIVE_TEXT]AT WAR![ENDCOLOR])
I am currently settling a dispute with {1_PlayerName:textkey}. ([COLOR_NEGATIVE_TEXT]AT WAR![ENDCOLOR])
Then you will be responsible for the consequences.
You are in the wrong here.
We have taken notice of the religious conversions you are undertaking inside our empire. We must ask you to cease this activity immediately!
Your vile beliefs pollute our lands and sully the morals of my people. Send your bringers of lies elsewhere, lest our religious differences spill over into bloodshed.
Enough is enough. Your incessant proselytism will be tolerated no longer. Stop sending your missionaries into my lands, or face the consequences.
One of my cities was recently burglarized and technological secrets were stolen. May I be assured that you had nothing to do with this?
I'm convinced you've been spying on my great civilization. You should stop before somebody gets hurt.

You will not regret your move to Autocracy. All within the state; nothing outside the state; nothing against the state. Only the strong leaders of strong states can bring the world into a glorious new era together.
The new world order of Autocracy is a force that cannot be denied. Your decision to join our cause was inevitable, and will lead to a great and triumphant future.
With celebration, we greet you in joining us in our quest for Freedom. Ask not what we can do individually, ask instead what we can do together.
You have made a wise and noble decision. The message of Freedom is one of compassion and acceptance, virtues that I hope you will embrace and share with others.
Give us the child for eight years and it will be a socialist forever. Your working class have heard this truth; now we welcome them to our revolutionary struggle for Order.
You have embraced Order, and will now be a part of our glorious future. It is a good thing, too, as our proletarian revolution shall soon claim the entire world!
We'd like to purchase a technology from you. Is this acceptable?
I'm sorry, but we haven't known one another for long enough for me to feel comfortable doing so. Perhaps we can revisit this subject in the future.
Making such a declaration at this point in our relationship would be premature. Maybe another time.
Friends? Already? We barely know each other.
Look, you are really nice, but I need some time to think about this level of commitment.
I'm sorry, but we haven't known you long enough to divulge our diplomatic secrets. Maybe in the future?
We haven't known each other long enough for me to reveal my foreign policy. The answer is no.
I only give away my foreign policy to those whom I trust. I cannot trust someone I've just met.
You drive a hard bargain. I accept.
It's nice when neighbors can get along so well.
Your offer is generous, and I accept.
Are you sure? I won't turn down such generosity.
I am humbled by this agreement.
It is agreed. I believe this deal will help restore our friendship.
What do you think of this?
I have a proposal for you.
Are you interested in this deal?
This is the most we can stomach to offer to you for your outrageous offer. Take it or leave it, fiend.
Bah! You are a fool to offer us so much. We will offer you far less, as you can see.
What makes you think we would match your offer, even if we could? This is what we will offer you.
An impossible offer that we cannot hope to match. You are simply embarrassing yourself, especially if you accept this trade.
This is the best we can do. If you accept this, you will be a laughing stock at home and in our country.
Want more? Too bad, this is all we can offer you. Go somewhere else if you don't like it.
You need to improve your pathetic trading skils. There is no way we can match your offer.
We cannot offer you enough to make this a fair trade. We can, however, offer you this deal.
The deal we suggest may be an unfair exchange for you. Please inspect it closely.
I'll take it, but I'm not sure this is a fair deal for you.
I'm sorry, but I can't match your offer. I can, however, offer you this.
This is all I can afford to offer you in exchange for your substantial offer.
It saddens me that I cannot offer you more for your great bounty.
This deal will work as it stands on the table.
The deal looks good to me as it is.
I'm sorry, I don't see a way to make this deal work.
There is no way to make this work.
We are not open to your offer at this time.
I have no interest in this agreement.
This is not at all acceptable. If you wish for us to get anywhere, you must offer a fair deal.
That is not even close to a fair deal.
You can do better than that.
Do you take me for a fool?
I'm afraid I must ask for more in exchange.
I'm sorry, but that offer is not in my favor.
That offer is not good enough.
Impossible. I know you can offer more than that.
This deal will not work if you won't offer a bit more.
You and I both know that you can offer a bit more.
I trusted you to defend us and you attacked us instead. What a shame.
How barbaric of you! You promised to protect our people and instead, you attack us! Make no mistake, I will kill you, and when I do, you will suffer.
You were our protector. It was said you would destroy our attackers, not join them! Bring prosperity to both of us, not leave us in darkness! You are lost, and now, the world shall know.
Who do you think you're talking to? My puppets won't leave me that easily. Now I will bring down your insurrection.
You honestly thought that I would let you go that easily? Ha! No... now prepare to die.
You're nuts, right? Did you honestly think I would be that pathetic? I will enjoy smashing your armies into pieces.
My people are grateful you have decided to grant us our independence.
Freeing my people is very generous of you. You have my gratitude.
Restoring our independence is very gracious of you. May this day be remembered for centuries to come.
Very well. Our people shall fight to the death to ensure our independence.
You have chosen to pointlessly spill your men's blood over this. Our people shall not shy away from independence.
Very well, then. We shall fight to the death to ensure our freedom.
Very well. We grant you your independence and recognize your people as an independent state.
I accept. You are free from my empire's control.
Understood. We accept your right to independence.
The time has come for my people to seek their own path in this world. We desire an independent nation. What say you?
Your occupation of our empire is no longer tolerable among my subjects and I am issuing a formal request that you allow my people to live as an individual sovereign state.
We believe the time has come to terminate our Vassalage agreement. Our people desire independent rule. Will you accept this?
We're tired of your pathetic rule over us and are prepared to fight to the death to regain our independence.
Relinquish control over our empire, or suffer the consequences. Which sounds like the smarter plan?
My people want independence and there's nothing you can do to stop us. Now, we can do this the easy way, or the hard way. The choice is yours.
This deal has faded in our eyes over the years. To renew this deal, we would need more from your side of the negotiation.
Our past agreements simply aren't what they used to be. If we're going to continue being friends, I'm going to need a bit more from you.
This was a great partnership, but is no longer. If you want to renew this deal, we expect a little bit more from you.
Unfortunately, I'm not sure this deal is as beneficial to us as it once was. Perhaps you could sweeten the deal?
Your highly aggressive behavior has not gone unnoticed. Should you keep it up, it will ultimately lead to your downfall.
It's clear you're a fairly uncivilized brute. I have to warn you, your actions are starting to attract quite a bit of attention.
Your warmongering is a popular topic these days. Better watch your back.
You're starting to attract quite a bit of attention. That's not a good thing.
Your conquests have lessened my opinion of you. Greatly.
Why must you be such a brute? Such warmongering will only lead to sour relations between us.
Your continued aggression draws great interest around the world. And not in a good way.
Just so you know, I have my eye on you. Bloodthirsty conquerors never win in the end.
I remain confident that my decision was the best for my people and my nation.
You wouldn't understand. I did what had to be done.
You have proven your diplomatic ignorance.
I remain confident that my decision was the best for my people and my nation.
You are mistaken in your views, and are thus on the wrong side of this discussion.

What is gold and what can I do with it?
Can ancient ruins give you more gold?
An ancient ruin may provide gold when it is explored.
How can I get gold from a barbarian encampment?
You'll earn gold each time you disperse a Barbarian Encampment.
Which buildings increase the output of gold?
Many buildings - markets, banks - increase a city's output of gold, especially if you assign merchant specialists to them.
How can I use gold to buy influence with city-states?
If you want to improve your relationship with a city-state, one way to do so is to give it some gold. Increasing amounts of gold may be given for larger boosts to friendship.
Do you get gold from capturing a city?
You may gain a bunch of gold when you capture a city (city-state or civilization's possession).
How can you get gold out of a city state?
A city-state may give you gold when you first meet. It may provide more later if you befriend it. (See the section on City-States for details.)
How can you gain gold through diplomacy?
You may gain gold - lump sum or an amount each turn for 30 turns - during negotiations with another civ.
What can I spend gold on?
How can I use gold in diplomacy?

You can exchange gold with other civilizations for any number of reasons - trading it for resources, for example, to get the other civ to make peace with you, or to bribe the civ to attack a third. Gold is extremely useful in negotiations.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]There are two different ways to exchange gold: flat fee and per turn.
There's lots of stuff to spend gold on.
What is a "flat fee" gold exchange in diplomacy?
A "Flat Fee" exchange is just that. You give or receive a one-time lump sum of gold, and then you're done.
{1_perTurn:number "#.##"} [ICON_GOLD] from Trade Routes established with this city

Ah, Gold! Gold is wonderful stuff. You can use it to build an army, to pay for a road network, to purchase buildings, to buy the friendship of a city-state and to bribe an enemy civilization.[NEWLINE]It may be true that "money can't buy you love," but it can purchase a nuclear submarine armed with nuclear missiles, and that's not bad.
[ICON_GOLD] Gold is stockpiled in the national treasury, and may be used to expand your territory, purchase items in Cities and as leverage in Diplomacy.
Do you lose gold if your city is captured?
If a civilization or city-state captures one of your cities, they take some of your gold (as well as the city).
How does gold work with building and unit maintenance costs?

Units and buildings both have "maintenance costs" that must be paid every turn. See the individual entries on the units and buildings for specific amounts. (Note that these maintenance costs are dependent upon the difficulty level at which you're playing.)
What is a "per turn" gold exchange in diplomacy?

You can also negotiate an exchange that occurs over a number of turns (usually 30). For example, you might agree to pay the other civ 5 gold per turn for 30 turns. These agreements are rendered null and void if the two civilizations go to war.
Does pillaging improvements provide any gold?
Pillaging an enemy improvement will heal your unit by 25 points, as well as give you a modest amount of gold.
Do you lose gold if barbarians take your city?
If the fiendish barbarians successfully attack one of your cities, they "plunder" some of your gold and you retain the city.
How can you expand your borders using gold?

You can extend your civilization's territory by purchasing individual tiles. Go to a City Screen, then click on "Buy a Tile." The map will display all tiles available for purchase. Click on the tile to expend the requisite gold and purchase the tile.
How can you use gold to units, buildings, or wonders?

You can spend gold to purchase units [COLOR_YELLOW]or invest in a building[ENDCOLOR] in a city. Click on a unit (if you can afford it!) and it will be immediately trained in the city, and the amount deducted from your treasury. [COLOR_YELLOW]If you click on a building, you will invest in it, reducing the production cost of the building by 50%, or 25% if it is a wonder.[ENDCOLOR][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Note that "projects" - the Manhattan Project, etc. - cannot be purchased.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][COLOR_YELLOW]The purchase costs of units and buildings increase slightly with the number of technologies you have researched.[ENDCOLOR]
Can I get gold from resources?
All Luxury resources (especially gold!) provide gold when worked.
How does gold work with road maintenance?
You spend gold for each road tile that you construct. If you absorb another civ's roads into your territory, you pay for their maintenance as well.
What happens if you run out of gold and are running a negative budget?

If your treasury is at zero and you're running a negative budget, the difference is deducted from your Science, and can eventually cause units to be disbanded. Beware: this can seriously slow down your acquisition of new technology, which can leave you extremely vulnerable to attack by more advanced neighbors. Get your budget in order as quickly as possible!
How can I get gold from the terrain?
These tiles provide gold when your citizens work them:[NEWLINE]- Coast Tiles[NEWLINE]- Ocean Tiles[NEWLINE]- River Tiles[NEWLINE]- Natural Wonders[NEWLINE]- Oasis
How can you use the great merchant to get lots of gold?
A Great Merchant can perform a "trade mission" in a city-state. The Merchant is expended and you get lots of gold. (See the section on Great People.)
How does a city connection produce gold?
How is a naval city connection blockaded?

An enemy naval unit within 2 tiles of a port city will "blockade" that city, rendering its harbor city connection inoperative until the enemy unit is driven off or destroyed. Citizens cannot work naval tiles that are blockaded.

If a City is connected by a road and/or [COLOR_YELLOW]along the same river (including via a Lake) and/or by a Lighthouse (i.e. both cities have a Lighthouse)[ENDCOLOR] to your Capital City, that City has a City Connection with the Capital. Each City Connection is worth a certain amount of Gold each turn, the amount determined by the size of the two cities.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][COLOR_GREEN]If a City is connected by a railroad and/or Seaport to your Capital City (i.e. both cities have a Seaport), that City has an Industrial City Connection with the Capital. An Industrial City Connection gives a production bonus to the targeted city, the amount determined by the size of the two cities. An Industrial City Connection also allows the construction of the Coaling Station, an industrial era building which gives a massive Production boost to the city.[ENDCOLOR]

Construct a Village improvement in a tile to increase its gold output. Earns additional gold and production if placed on a Road or Railroad that connects two owned cities (that are both connected to the Capital) and/or if a Trade Route, either internal or international, passes over it. Cannot be built adjacent to one another.
A unit must be in your territory to be upgraded.

Over time, you'll learn new technologies that will allow you to create better military units than those you previously could. When this occurs, you'll have the option to "upgrade" the older units, turning them into the newer, more powerful models. (For example, once you learn Iron Working, you can upgrade any Warrior units you possess into Swordsmen.) Each upgrade costs some gold - the more powerful the upgrade, the more expensive it will be.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]A unit must be in your territory to be upgraded. When an upgrade is available for a unit, the "Upgrade" button will appear in the unit's Action list.
Where can I get more gold?
Gold comes from a variety of sources. You'll get most of your gold by working the tiles around your cities, but other sources are available as well.
How do wonders interact with gold?

Some Wonders provide or increase a city's output of gold. Check out Machu Picchu and the Colossus.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Also, if you're constructing a Wonder and another civ finishes it before you do, you get a gold bonus (the size of the bonus depends upon how much progress you've made on the Wonder).

+2 [ICON_GOLD] Gold and [ICON_CULTURE] Culture from all Villages, Towns, and Lakes worked by the City. +5 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture from nearby Oasis. 5% of [ICON_GOLD] Gold created by the City counts as [ICON_CULTURE] Culture Per Turn.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]1 Specialist in this City no longer produces [ICON_HAPPINESS_3] Unhappiness from [ICON_URBANIZATION] Urbanization.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]City [COLOR_NEGATIVE_TEXT]cannot have[ENDCOLOR] a Ski Resort or Marina.

Rather than turning your City into a major tourist destination with the Marina or Ski Resort, you can keep it exclusive to your own wealthy upper class with the Country Club. You can still receive Gold and Culture from Tiles, but not Tourism. Furthermore, instead of producing Gold from Tourism, you will produce a smaller amount of Culture from Gold.
